title: Name/secure the License+Compliance reviewer (blocking, non-skippable gate role)
context: Before any dataset is downloaded or processed, the project requires a named, qualified License+Compliance reviewer with proteomics and data-license/privacy competence. This role has veto authority over all allow-list entries and the controlled-access refusal — it is a hard M0 exit criterion. Without a named reviewer in the seat, no dataset advances past 'pending', M0 cannot exit, and the maintainer must escalate to Hee-Lee Oss governance. The empty-seat fallback must also be documented.
objective: Identify, vet, and secure a commitment from a qualified individual to serve as the License+Compliance reviewer for all dataset allow-list decisions, re-identification determinations, and controlled-access refusals on this project.
acceptanceCriteria: A named, qualified person (with proteomics background and data-license/privacy competence) has accepted the License+Compliance reviewer seat in writing before any dataset is downloaded or processed.
The reviewer's veto authority over allowlist.yml entries and the controlled-access refusal is documented in the project governance record.
The empty-seat fallback is recorded: no dataset advances past 'pending', M0 cannot exit, and the maintainer escalates to Hee-Lee Oss governance to source a qualified reviewer if the seat is unfilled.
A document capturing the reviewer's name, qualifications, scope of authority, and fallback procedure is committed to the project repo and licensed CC-BY-4.0.
resources: TASKS.md — M0 acceptance criteria for reviewer-001
CLAUDE.md — Hee-Lee Oss work rules and refusal guardrails
output: A committed project governance record naming the License+Compliance reviewer, documenting their veto authority, and recording the empty-seat fallback procedure.
